items.title: Interval Between Injury and Surgery Influences Knee Biomechanics During Walking in Anterior Cruciate Ligament Reconstructed Patients: A Systematic Review with Meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 16 studies (18-55 years) found ACLR patients have lower peak knee flexion angle (SMD = -0.33), peak knee adduction angle (SMD = -0.47), and peak knee flexion moment (SMD = -0.64) during walking. Delayed reconstruction (≥ 12 months) is associated with persistent sagittal plane deficits, while early surgery (< 6 months) is linked to fewer long-term sagittal-plane deficits but temporary frontal-plane asymmetries and extension deficits.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述明确指出，ACL 重建术（ACLR）后步态生物力学异常与伤后至手术间隔时间有关。长期延迟手术（≥ 12 个月）与持续性矢状面缺陷相关，而早期手术（< 6 个月）虽早期有额状面不对称和伸展缺陷，但长期矢状面缺陷较少。你规划 ACLR 患者康复时，必须考虑手术时机，针对性地调整康复策略，尤其是对于延迟手术的患者，需更多关注其矢状面功能的恢复。
items.titleZh: 伤后至手术间隔时间影响前交叉韧带重建患者步行时的膝关节生物力学：一项系统综述与 Meta 分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 16 项研究（18-55 岁）的系统综述和 Meta 分析发现，ACL 重建患者在步行时表现出较低的膝关节屈曲峰值角度（SMD = -0.33）、内收峰值角度（SMD = -0.47）和屈曲峰值力矩（SMD = -0.64）。延迟重建（≥ 12 个月）与持续性矢状面缺陷相关，而早期手术（< 6 个月）与较少的长期矢状面缺陷相关，但可能伴有暂时的额状面不对称和伸展缺陷。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review clarifies that altered walking biomechanics post-ACLR are related to the interval between injury and surgery. Delayed surgery (≥ 12 months) is associated with persistent sagittal plane deficits, while early surgery (< 6 months) shows fewer long-term sagittal plane deficits despite early frontal plane asymmetries and extension deficits. When planning rehabilitation for ACLR patients, you must consider surgical timing to tailor strategies, particularly focusing on sagittal plane recovery for those with delayed surgery.
items.limitation: 纳入研究的方法学质量中等（平均 65%），且存在高异质性（I² ≥ 57%），这可能影响了结果的确定性和推断强度。
items.limitationEn: The included studies had moderate methodological quality (average 65%) and high heterogeneity (I² ≥ 57%), which may affect the certainty and strength of the conclusions.

items.title: Physiotherapy and Exercise-Based Rehabilitation for Mental Health: A Two-Decade Bibliometric Analysis of Global Trends, Thematic Evolution, and the Socioeconomic Vulnerability Gap (2006-2025).
items.summary: A bibliometric analysis of 5223 publications (2006-2025) on physical rehabilitation and mental health showed a 22.6-fold increase in publications. Research is concentrated in high-income countries (75.9%), with socioeconomic vulnerability explicitly referenced in only 4.6% of publications, highlighting it as an under-researched area.
items.curatedReason: 这项文献计量分析显示，物理治疗和运动康复在精神健康领域的文献量显著增长，但研究重心仍高度集中在高收入国家。它提醒你，在规划研究或寻求资助时，应关注低收入环境、成本效益评估和实施科学，以填补社会经济脆弱性这一关键且尚未充分探索的空白，确保研究成果能转化为更公平的干预措施。
items.titleZh: 物理治疗和运动康复对精神健康的影响：一项全球趋势、主题演变和社会经济脆弱性差距的二十年文献计量分析（2006-2025）
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 5223 份关于物理康复与精神健康的出版物（2006-2025 年）的文献计量分析显示，出版量增长了 22.6 倍。研究主要集中在高收入国家（75.9%），仅有 4.6% 的出版物明确提及社会经济脆弱性，凸显其为一个尚未充分研究的领域。
items.curatedReasonEn: This bibliometric analysis shows substantial growth in physical therapy and exercise rehabilitation literature for mental health, yet research remains concentrated in high-income countries. It prompts you to focus on low-resource settings, cost-effectiveness evaluations, and implementation science when planning research or seeking funding, to address the critical and underexplored gap of socioeconomic vulnerability and ensure equitable interventions.
items.limitation: 文献计量学研究的局限性在于其结果依赖于关键词和数据库检索策略，可能无法捕捉所有相关研究，尤其是在未明确标记社会经济脆弱性的研究中。此外，对2026年数据的纳入，作为预测而非实际已发表数据，也可能带来偏差。
items.limitationEn: The limitation of bibliometric studies is their reliance on keywords and database search strategies, which may not capture all relevant research, especially those not explicitly tagged with socioeconomic vulnerability. Additionally, the inclusion of 2026 data as projections rather than actual published data may introduce bias.

items.title: Experiences of physiotherapists in managing pelvic floor disorders at public hospitals in uThukela district, South Africa.
items.summary: A qualitative study with 12 physiotherapists in South Africa's uThukela district identified limited undergraduate training, inadequate resources, understaffing, and poor referral pathways as barriers to managing pelvic floor disorders in public hospitals.
items.curatedReason: 本研究揭示了南非公立医院物理治疗师在管理盆底障碍（PFD）方面面临的挑战，如本科培训不足、资源匮乏、人员不足及转诊路径不畅。这些发现可指导当地改善教育和资源分配，但其区域性限制了普遍适用性。

items.curatedReasonEn: This study highlights challenges faced by physiotherapists in managing pelvic floor disorders (PFDs) in South African public hospitals, including insufficient undergraduate training, limited resources, understaffing, and poor referral pathways. These findings can guide local improvements in education and resource allocation, though their regional specificity limits universal applicability.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性描述性研究，样本量小（12 名物理治疗师），结果主要反映南非 uThukela 地区的特定背景，外推至其他地区或国家的适用性有限。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative descriptive study with a small sample (12 physiotherapists) primarily reflects the specific context of the uThukela district in South Africa, limiting its generalizability to other regions or countries.

items.title: Health-seeking behaviours of people with osteoarthritis in sub-Saharan Africa: A scoping review.
items.summary: A scoping review of five studies from sub-Saharan Africa found that health-seeking behavior for osteoarthritis is largely delayed or fragmented, influenced by intrapersonal, interpersonal, organizational, and community factors, highlighting barriers like beliefs, poor knowledge, and limited access to rehabilitation.
items.curatedReason: 这项范围综述揭示了撒哈拉以南非洲骨关节炎患者求医行为受文化信仰、健康素养和医疗系统多重影响。它提醒你，在低收入地区执业时，需要加强患者教育、推广自我管理和拓展社区康复，同时改进转诊路径，以应对延迟就医和康复服务可及性差的现状。
items.titleZh: 撒哈拉以南非洲骨关节炎患者的健康寻求行为：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项针对撒哈拉以南非洲五项研究的范围综述发现，骨关节炎患者的健康寻求行为普遍延迟或碎片化，受个体、人际、组织和社区因素影响，突出表现为信念、知识匮乏和康复服务可及性受限等障碍。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review reveals that health-seeking behaviors of people with osteoarthritis in sub-Saharan Africa are influenced by cultural beliefs, health literacy, and healthcare systems. It reminds you to enhance patient education, promote self-management, expand community-based rehabilitation, and improve referral pathways when practicing in low-resource settings, addressing delayed help-seeking and limited access to rehabilitation services.
items.limitation: 本范围综述仅纳入 5 项研究，且全部来自农村地区，代表性有限，可能未能全面反映撒哈拉以南非洲地区骨关节炎患者的健康寻求行为。
items.limitationEn: This scoping review included only 5 studies, all from rural settings, limiting its representativeness and potentially not fully capturing health-seeking behaviors of people with osteoarthritis across sub-Saharan Africa.

items.title: Exercise-based rehabilitation interventions for kinesiophobia after total knee arthroplasty: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 11 RCTs (N = 1,096) found that exercise-based rehabilitation was associated with a reduction in kinesiophobia (SMD = -1.22) and improvements in knee function (SMD = 1.19) at ≤ 4 weeks post-TKA, although the certainty of evidence was low.
items.curatedReason: 术后全膝关节置换术（TKA）患者，早期（≤ 4 周）运动康复确可显著降低运动恐惧，并改善膝关节功能。尽管现有证据确定性不高，但这个发现支持我们应坚持早期运动干预。
items.titleZh: 全膝关节置换术后运动恐惧症的运动康复干预：一项随机对照试验的系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 11 项随机对照试验（N=1,096）的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，运动康复与全膝关节置换术后 ≤ 4 周的运动恐惧症（SMD = -1.22）和膝关节功能改善（SMD = 1.19）相关，但证据确定性较低。
items.curatedReasonEn: For patients post-TKA, early (≤ 4 weeks) exercise rehabilitation significantly reduces kinesiophobia and improves knee function. While the certainty of evidence is low, this finding reinforces our practice of prioritizing early exercise intervention.
items.limitation: 本研究的证据确定性较低，且存在显著的异质性，结果的稳健性和效应量可能不稳定。
items.limitationEn: The certainty of evidence in this study is low, with substantial heterogeneity, suggesting that the robustness of results and effect sizes may be unstable.

items.title: Comparative Effects of Neurostimulation- and Technology-Augmented Robot-Assisted Training on Upper-Limb Motor Recovery After Stroke: A Systematic Review and Network Meta-Analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and network meta-analysis of 103 trials (N = 5,251) found rTMS plus robot-assisted training (RAT) yielded the largest FMA-UE estimate (MD 9.56 points), followed by LFES plus RAT (MD 7.52) compared to usual care, with RAT alone showing smaller gains (MD 3.83).
items.curatedReason: 这项网络荟萃分析指出，结合重复经颅磁刺激（rTMS）或低频电刺激（LFES）的机器人辅助训练，比单纯机器人辅助训练更能显著改善卒中后上肢运动功能。这提示你可以在现有机器人康复方案中，积极考虑纳入神经调控技术以期获得更优疗效。
items.titleZh: 神经刺激与技术增强型机器人辅助训练对卒中后上肢运动恢复的比较效应：一项系统综述和网络荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 103 项试验（N=5,251）的系统综述和网络荟萃分析发现，与常规护理相比，重复经颅磁刺激（rTMS）结合机器人辅助训练（RAT）对上肢富格尔-梅耶评估（FMA-UE）改善最大（平均差 9.56 分），其次是低频电刺激（LFES）结合 RAT（平均差 7.52 分），单纯 RAT 改善较小（平均差 3.83 分）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This network meta-analysis suggests that robot-assisted training combined with rTMS or LFES significantly improves upper-limb motor recovery post-stroke compared to robot-assisted training alone. This indicates you might proactively consider integrating neuromodulation techniques into existing robotic rehabilitation protocols for better outcomes.
items.limitation: 研究存在显著异质性且头对头证据稀少，加上证据确定性为非常低到中等，尚不能得出明确的干预优先级。
items.limitationEn: The study has substantial heterogeneity and sparse head-to-head evidence, combined with very low-to-moderate certainty, precluding a definitive hierarchy of interventions.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Inertial measurement unit-based gait analysis for objective assessment of vestibular rehabilitation.
items.summary: An observational study of 30 AVS participants found that IMU-based gait analysis, even with a single pelvis sensor, captured significant improvements in walking speed, Gait Profile Score, and cadence after 6 weeks of vestibular rehabilitation, supporting its clinical feasibility for assessment.
items.curatedReason: IMU 传感器（包括单传感器）在急性前庭综合征（AVS）患者的步态分析中展现出良好的可行性，可作为评估前庭康复进展的客观工具。这提示你可以考虑将可穿戴设备纳入日常评估，以量化患者的进步。
items.titleZh: 基于惯性测量单元的步态分析对前庭康复的客观评估
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 30 名急性前庭综合征患者的观察性研究发现，即使是单骨盆 IMU 传感器也能捕捉到前庭康复 6 周后步行速度、步态姿态评分和步频的显著改善，支持其作为康复评估的临床可行性。
items.curatedReasonEn: IMU sensors, including single-sensor setups, demonstrate good feasibility for gait analysis in patients with acute vestibular syndrome (AVS) and can serve as objective tools for assessing vestibular rehabilitation progress. This suggests you could consider incorporating wearable devices into your routine assessments to quantify patient improvement.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量相对较小（30 例 AVS 患者），且缺乏长期随访数据来评估 IMU 在更长时间康复效果中的表现。
items.limitationEn: This study has a relatively small sample size (30 AVS participants) and lacks long-term follow-up data to evaluate IMU performance in assessing rehabilitation outcomes over extended periods.

items.title: Midlife mobility assessment from the pocket: agreement and consistency between smartphone placement configurations
items.summary: A study of 46 adults (aged 40-64) found strong correlations and good-to-excellent consistency for balance, sit-to-stand repetition count, and Timed Up and Go total duration between smartphone placements at the lower back and pocket/thigh, supporting practical midlife mobility assessment.
items.curatedReason: 智能手机放在口袋或大腿位置进行平衡、坐站和计时起立行走测试，其结果与标准下背部放置的测量结果高度一致，尤其是重复次数和总时长。这提示你可在临床实践中探索更便捷的智能手机移动性评估方式，提高评估依从性和居家监测潜力。
items.titleZh: 从口袋评估中年移动性：智能手机放置配置之间的一致性和连贯性
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 46 名（40-64 岁）成年人的研究发现，智能手机在下背部与口袋/大腿位置的平衡、坐站重复次数和计时起立行走总时长测量结果之间具有强相关性和良好至极佳的一致性，支持其在中年移动性评估中的实际应用。
items.curatedReasonEn: Smartphone placement in the pocket or on the thigh for balance, sit-to-stand, and Timed Up and Go tests shows high agreement with standard lower-back placement, especially for repetition counts and total duration. This suggests you can explore more convenient smartphone-based mobility assessments in clinical practice to improve adherence and home monitoring potential.
items.limitation: 某些运动衍生指标（如坐站功率和最大垂直速度）在不同放置位置间相关性较弱，可能需要进一步验证才能推广应用。
items.limitationEn: Some movement-derived measures (e.g., STS power and maximal vertical velocity) showed weaker correlations between different placements, which may require further validation before widespread application.

items.title: Effects of chair-based exercise training on pulmonary function, exercise capacity, and quality of life in patients with acute exacerbation of COPD: A randomised controlled trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=30) found that chair-based exercise training in patients hospitalized with acute COPD exacerbations significantly improved functional exercise capacity (mean 6MWT distance change 50.9 m [95% CI 2.09-99.76]; p=0.042), dyspnea, and quality of life compared to breathing exercises alone.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 坐实了在 COPD 急性加重期住院期间进行椅上运动训练是可行的，并且能显著改善患者的功能运动能力（6MWT 距离改善 50.9 米）、呼吸困难和生活质量。这提示你应该把椅上运动纳入 COPD 住院患者的常规康复方案。
items.titleZh: 椅上运动训练对急性加重期 COPD 患者肺功能、运动能力和生活质量的影响：一项随机对照试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=30）发现，对急性加重期 COPD 住院患者进行椅上运动训练，功能运动能力（6MWT 距离平均改善 50.9 米 [95% CI 2.09-99.76]；p=0.042）、呼吸困难和生活质量均显著优于单独进行呼吸训练。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT confirms that chair-based exercise training is feasible during hospitalization for acute COPD exacerbations and significantly improves functional exercise capacity (6MWT distance improved by 50.9 m), dyspnea, and quality of life. This suggests you should integrate chair-based exercise into routine rehabilitation protocols for hospitalized COPD patients.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小，限制了结果的普适性。
items.limitationEn: The small sample size limits the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Effects of low-dose cervical paraspinal lidocaine injections on cervicogenic dizziness-related outcomes: a randomized, sham-controlled, assessor-blinded trial.
items.summary: A randomized, sham-controlled trial (n=81) found low-dose cervical paraspinal lidocaine injections improved Dizziness Handicap Inventory total score by -6.78 points (95% CI -8.21 to -5.36; p < 0.001) in cervicogenic dizziness, which was statistically significant but below the 11-point minimal important change.
items.curatedReason: 低剂量颈椎旁利多卡因注射液虽能统计学显著改善颈源性眩晕的DHI总分，但-6.78分的改善量低于11分的最小临床重要变化。别指望它能带来实质性的临床改善，更不应替代主动康复，但它提示多模式干预中这一方法的有限作用。
items.titleZh: 低剂量颈椎旁利多卡因注射对颈源性眩晕相关结局的影响：一项随机、假对照、评估者盲法试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项随机、假对照试验（n=81）发现，低剂量颈椎旁利多卡因注射可使颈源性眩晕患者的眩晕残疾量表总分改善 -6.78 分（95% CI -8.21 至 -5.36；p < 0.001），统计学意义显著，但低于 11 分的最小临床重要改变。
items.curatedReasonEn: While low-dose cervical paraspinal lidocaine injections statistically significantly improved DHI scores in cervicogenic dizziness, the -6.78 point improvement falls short of the 11-point minimal clinically important change. Do not expect substantial clinical improvement from this intervention, and certainly do not substitute it for active rehabilitation. This highlights the limited role of such an approach within multimodal interventions.
items.limitation: 该试验没有验证受试者盲法，且缺乏长期随访，也未与康复干预相结合进行评估。
items.limitationEn: The trial did not verify participant blinding, lacked long-term follow-up, and was not evaluated in conjunction with rehabilitation interventions.

items.title: Efficacy of real-time feedback exercise therapy in patients following total hip arthroplasty: a pilot cluster-randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A pilot cluster-randomized controlled trial with 22 patients found that real-time feedback-assisted home exercise after THA did not significantly differ from standard written instructions in improving function or quality of life, but the intervention group reported greater motivation and self-confidence.
items.curatedReason: 对于全髋关节置换术（THA）术后患者，实时反馈辅助家庭锻炼在改善功能和生活质量方面并未显示出优于标准书面指导的显著差异。但注意它提示了患者有更高的动机和信心。
items.titleZh: 全髋关节置换术后患者实时反馈运动疗法的疗效：一项试点集群随机对照试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项对 22 名患者进行的试点集群随机对照试验发现，全髋关节置换术（THA）后实时反馈辅助家庭锻炼在改善功能和生活质量方面与标准书面指导无显著差异，但干预组报告了更高的动机和自信。
items.curatedReasonEn: Real-time feedback-assisted home exercise did not show significant differences in improving function and quality of life compared to standard written instructions for patients after total hip arthroplasty (THA). However, it did suggest higher patient motivation and confidence.
items.limitation: 这是一项小样本的试点试验，且患者对干预的盲法未经验证。
items.limitationEn: This is a small-sample pilot trial, and patient blinding to the intervention was not verified.

items.title: e-health in musculoskeletal primary care physiotherapy: Evidence, facilitators, and barriers - A scoping review.
items.summary: A scoping review of 45 studies found e-Health is well-received in musculoskeletal primary care physiotherapy, particularly blended care, with internet-based solutions, mobile apps, and video consultations being most common. However, patient and clinician barriers persist, highlighting the need for clear guidelines and structured training.
items.curatedReason: 这份范围综述概述了初级保健物理治疗中电子健康（e-Health）解决方案的现状，为你清晰呈现了主流技术、应用方式，以及推广中可能遇到的患者和临床医生双重障碍。它能帮你思考如何更好地将数字工具融入实践。
items.titleZh: 肌肉骨骼初级保健物理治疗中的电子健康：证据、促进因素和障碍——一项范围综述。
items.summaryZh: 一项涵盖 45 项研究的范围综述发现，电子健康（e-Health）在肌肉骨骼初级保健物理治疗中（特别是混合护理）广受欢迎，以互联网解决方案、移动应用和视频咨询最为常见。但患者和临床医生面临的障碍依然存在，提示需制定明确指南和系统培训。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review outlines the current landscape of e-Health solutions in primary care physiotherapy, clearly presenting mainstream technologies, application methods, and potential patient and clinician barriers to adoption. It helps you consider how to better integrate digital tools into your practice.
items.limitation: 研究方法和电子健康模式存在异质性，且多数研究来自高收入国家，可能限制其普适性。
items.limitationEn: Heterogeneity in study methods and e-Health modalities, with a predominance of studies from high-income countries, may limit generalizability.

items.title: Effect of Incorporating Perceptual Learning Into Plantar Hardness Discrimination on the Risk of Falling and Muscle Torque in Patients With Hemiplegia: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=34) found that incorporating perceptual learning into plantar hardness discrimination significantly lowered fall risk (ES=1.48), increased knee extensor torque (ES=1.19), and improved FIM scores (ES=1.56) in hemiplegic stroke patients compared to a control group.
items.curatedReason: 将足底硬度辨别知觉学习纳入偏瘫患者康复方案，能显著降低跌倒风险，并增强膝关节伸肌扭矩。这是卒中康复中神经可塑性干预的一个新方向，值得临床关注。
items.titleZh: 将足底硬度辨别知觉学习纳入偏瘫患者康复对跌倒风险和肌肉扭矩的影响：一项随机对照试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=34）发现，在偏瘫患者的康复方案中加入足底硬度辨别知觉学习，可显著降低跌倒风险（ES=1.48），增加膝关节伸肌扭矩（ES=1.19），并改善功能独立性量表（FIM）评分（ES=1.56）。
items.curatedReasonEn: Incorporating perceptual learning with plantar hardness discrimination into rehabilitation programs for hemiplegic patients significantly reduces fall risk and enhances knee extensor torque. This offers a novel direction for neuroplasticity-focused interventions in stroke rehabilitation and warrants clinical attention.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（34名患者），且为单中心研究，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: The study has a relatively small sample size (34 patients) and is single-center, limiting the generalizability of the findings.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Comparative effectiveness of different physical therapies for axillary web syndrome after breast cancer surgery: A network meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials.
items.summary: A network meta-analysis of 14 RCTs (1007 patients) found that soft tissue manual therapy + therapeutic exercise + low-level laser therapy significantly reduced pain (SMD = -4.40) and improved shoulder abduction (MD = 59.51) and flexion (MD = 77.30) in axillary web syndrome. Manual lymphatic drainage + therapeutic exercise showed the largest improvement in upper-limb disability (MD = -19.01).
items.curatedReason: 腋网综合征的治疗有了更清晰的证据排名：软组织手法、治疗性运动与低强度激光三联疗法对疼痛和肩关节活动度最佳；淋巴引流与治疗性运动则最能改善上肢功能。你应根据患者主诉调整干预组合。
items.titleZh: 乳腺癌术后腋网综合征不同物理疗法的比较疗效：一项随机对照试验的网络荟萃分析。
items.summaryZh: 一项包含14项随机对照试验（1007名患者）的网络荟萃分析发现，软组织手法治疗+治疗性运动+低强度激光疗法显著减轻腋网综合征疼痛（SMD = -4.40）并改善肩关节外展（MD = 59.51）和屈曲（MD = 77.30）。手动淋巴引流+治疗性运动对上肢功能障碍的改善最大（MD = -19.01）。
items.curatedReasonEn: The treatment of axillary web syndrome now has clearer evidence ranking: the combination of soft tissue manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and low-level laser therapy is most effective for pain and shoulder ROM, while manual lymphatic drainage with therapeutic exercise best improves upper limb function. Adjust your intervention mix based on patient chief complaints.
items.limitation: 该网络荟萃分析纳入研究数量有限（14项RCT），存在临床异质性，且部分结果在随机效应模型中可信区间跨越无效线，证据确定性受限。
items.limitationEn: This network meta-analysis included a limited number of studies (14 RCTs), exhibited clinical heterogeneity, and some results had credible intervals crossing the null in random-effects models, limiting evidence certainty.

items.title: Efficacy of Manual Physiotherapy Techniques for Improving Cervical Range of Motion in Infants With Congenital Muscular Torticollis: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of five RCTs (n=143 infants) found a statistically significant pooled effect (Cohen's d = 0.90, 95% CI: 0.54 to 1.27, p < 0.001) in favor of manual physiotherapy techniques for improving cervical ROM in infants with congenital muscular torticollis.
items.curatedReason: 手法物理治疗技术能显著改善先天性肌性斜颈婴儿的颈椎活动度，证据级别足够高（5项RCTs的系统综述），你应更自信地将其作为主要早期干预手段。别再犹豫了，这些婴儿的ROM改善效果达大效应量（Cohen's d = 0.90）。
items.titleZh: 手动物理治疗技术对改善先天性肌性斜颈婴儿颈椎活动度的疗效：一项系统综述和荟萃分析。
items.summaryZh: 一项包含五项随机对照试验（n=143名婴儿）的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，手动物理治疗技术在改善先天性肌性斜颈婴儿颈椎活动度方面有统计学显著的综合效应（Cohen's d = 0.90, 95% CI: 0.54 to 1.27, p < 0.001）。
items.curatedReasonEn: Manual physiotherapy techniques significantly improve cervical ROM in infants with congenital muscular torticollis, with high-level evidence (a systematic review of 5 RCTs). You should confidently integrate this as a primary early intervention. The effect size is large (Cohen's d = 0.90), so don't hesitate.
items.limitation: 纳入研究数量有限（5项RCT），干预方案存在差异，且缺乏长期随访数据。
items.limitationEn: The meta-analysis included a limited number of studies (5 RCTs), intervention protocols varied, and long-term follow-up data is scarce.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Five Days of Acute Intermittent Hypoxia Is Safe and Improves Somatic Motor Function in Persons with Multiple Sclerosis
items.summary: A randomized, double-masked, placebo-controlled crossover trial (n=23 MS patients) found that 5 days of acute intermittent hypoxia (AIH) significantly increased ankle plantarflexion torque (beta = 8.74 Nm, p < 0.001) and 6-minute walk distance (beta = 10.14 m, p = 0.039) compared to Sham, with no serious adverse events.
items.curatedReason: 这项随机对照交叉试验显示，每日急性间歇性低氧（AIH）对多发性硬化症（MS）患者是安全且耐受的，并能显著改善踝关节跖屈力量和步行耐力。你可考虑将AIH作为增强MS患者神经可塑性和康复效果的辅助手段，特别是在结合特定任务步态训练时。
items.titleZh: 五天急性间歇性低氧对多发性硬化症患者安全且可改善躯体运动功能。
items.summaryZh: 一项随机、双盲、安慰剂对照交叉试验（n=23名MS患者）发现，与假治疗相比，为期5天的急性间歇性低氧（AIH）显著增加了踝关节跖屈扭矩（beta = 8.74 Nm, p < 0.001）和6分钟步行距离（beta = 10.14 m, p = 0.039），且未报告严重不良事件。
items.curatedReasonEn: This randomized controlled crossover trial shows that daily acute intermittent hypoxia (AIH) is safe and well-tolerated in persons with multiple sclerosis (MS) and significantly improves ankle plantarflexion strength and walking endurance. You may consider AIH as an adjunct to enhance neuroplasticity and rehabilitation outcomes in MS patients, especially when combined with task-specific gait training.
items.limitation: 研究样本量相对较小（23名患者），且随访时间有限，长期效果尚待确认。
items.limitationEn: The study has a relatively small sample size (23 patients) and limited follow-up duration, with long-term effects yet to be confirmed.

items.title: Final 2027 Physician Fee Schedule Has Mixed Payment Impact for Physical Therapy
items.summary: APTA reports on CMS's final 2027 Physician Fee Schedule, noting a mixed impact for physical therapy. CMS reduced conversion factors, but secured yearly payment increases for top-billed PT codes for the next several years.
items.curatedReason: CMS 发布了2027年医师收费标准最终规则，对物理治疗师而言，虽然转换因子有所下调，但高频PT代码在未来几年将获得年度支付增长。你需要仔细研究具体代码的费率调整，以优化你的报销策略。
items.titleZh: 2027年医师收费标准最终规则对物理治疗的支付影响喜忧参半 | APTA。

items.title: Machine Learning Prediction of Independent Walking 8 Weeks After Rehabilitation in Patients With Stroke: A Retrospective Study.
items.summary: A retrospective cohort study (n=169 stroke patients) comparing machine learning models for predicting independent walking 8 weeks post-rehabilitation found that neural networks had the highest AUC (0.884) and average precision (0.771). Baseline Berg Balance Scale (BBS) and somatosensory evoked potential (SEP) severity were leading predictors.
items.curatedReason: 机器学习模型在预测卒中患者康复8周后独立行走能力方面表现良好，神经网络模型AUC最高，提示感觉通路完整性是重要预测因子。临床上你可将其作为辅助评估工具，但需等待外部验证。
items.titleZh: 机器学习预测卒中患者康复8周后独立行走能力：一项回顾性研究。
items.summaryZh: 一项回顾性队列研究（n=169名卒中患者）比较了机器学习模型在预测康复8周后独立行走方面的表现，发现神经网络模型具有最高的AUC（0.884）和平均精度（0.771）。基线BBS和体感诱发电位（SEP）严重程度是主要预测因子。
items.curatedReasonEn: Machine learning models, particularly neural networks with the highest AUC, show good performance in predicting independent walking ability 8 weeks post-stroke rehabilitation, highlighting somatosensory pathway integrity as a key predictor. You can consider this as an auxiliary assessment tool, but await external validation.
items.limitation: 这项回顾性单中心队列研究的发现需进行外部验证才能用于临床实践。
items.limitationEn: The findings of this retrospective single-center cohort study require external validation before clinical implementation.

items.title: Unpacking the Success: An Ecological Systems Perspective on Distance Running Performance in Ethiopia
items.summary: A mixed-methods study (n=145 Ethiopian distance runners) found that primary education level (OR=5.80), normal BMI (OR=2.85), and academy training (OR=2.40) were significant quantitative predictors of high performance. Qualitative themes highlighted hardship, community support, and the balance between tradition and modernization in training.
items.curatedReason: 想培养高水平长跑运动员，别只盯着生理指标。这项针对埃塞俄比亚跑者的观察研究提示，初等教育（OR=5.80）、正常BMI（OR=2.85）和学院训练（OR=2.40）是重要的表现预测因子。更重要的是，社区支持和社会经济背景等宏观因素可能同样关键。
items.titleZh: 剖析成功：从生态系统视角看埃塞俄比亚长跑表现 | Sports Medicine - Open。
items.summaryZh: 一项混合方法研究（n=145名埃塞俄比亚长跑运动员）发现，小学教育水平（OR=5.80）、正常BMI（OR=2.85）和学院训练（OR=2.40）是高水平表现的显著定量预测因子。定性主题强调了训练中的艰辛、社区支持以及传统与现代化的平衡。
items.curatedReasonEn: Don't just focus on physiological metrics for high-performance distance runners. This observational study on Ethiopian runners suggests primary education (OR=5.80), normal BMI (OR=2.85), and academy training (OR=2.40) are significant predictors. Crucially, macro factors like community support and socioeconomic background may be just as vital.
items.limitation: 研究采用混合方法，但量化部分为观察性，结果存在潜在混杂因素，且模型外推性需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: The study used a mixed-methods approach, but the quantitative section is observational, with potential confounders and limited generalizability of the models.

items.title: The MSK Playbook: Hamstring Strain Injuries - BJSM blog - social media's leading SEM voice
items.summary: A BJSM blog post reviews hamstring strain injuries, which account for 24% of all professional football injuries, with recurrence rates exceeding 30%. The article explores injury mechanisms, biomechanics, imaging use, and rehab protocols, emphasizing the complex challenges in management.
items.curatedReason: 这篇指南性文章回顾了腘绳肌拉伤的损伤机制、成像应用和康复方案，强调了这种常见运动损伤的高复发率。它提醒你评估和管理腘绳肌拉伤需要全面考虑生物力学、神经学和心理社会因素。
items.titleZh: MSK 剧本：腘绳肌拉伤 - BJSM 博客 - 社交媒体领先的运动医学之声。
items.summaryZh: BJSM 博客文章回顾了腘绳肌拉伤，这种损伤占所有职业足球损伤的24%，复发率超过30%。文章探讨了损伤机制、生物力学、影像学应用和康复方案，强调了管理中的复杂挑战。
items.curatedReasonEn: This guidance article reviews hamstring strain injury mechanisms, imaging applications, and rehabilitation protocols, highlighting the high recurrence rate of this common sports injury. It reminds you that assessing and managing hamstring strains requires a holistic consideration of biomechanical, neurological, and psychosocial factors.

items.title: Altered Cognitive Control and Cortical Oscillatory Dynamics in Athletes With ACL Reconstruction During Decision-Making Under Uncertainty.
items.summary: A study of 90 open-skill athletes (45 non-ACLR, 45 ACLR) found ACLR athletes exhibited slower response times and lower accuracy (d = 0.75-1.09) during a probabilistic go/no-go task, along with attenuated prestimulus midfrontal theta power (d = 0.60) and reduced left-lateralized central beta (d = 0.61) and posterior alpha suppression (d = 0.55) during target phase.
items.curatedReason: ACL重建（ACLR）运动员在不确定决策情境下表现出持续的神经认知改变，这可能增加再受伤风险。你在评估ACLR运动员重返赛场时，应考虑纳入神经认知评估，而不只是传统的体能测试。
items.titleZh: ACL重建运动员在不确定性决策中认知控制和皮层振荡动力学的改变
items.summaryZh: 一项对90名开放技能运动员（45名非ACLR，45名ACLR）的研究发现，ACLR运动员在概率性Go/No-Go任务中反应时间较慢、准确性较低（d = 0.75-1.09），且在目标刺激阶段，刺激前中额θ波功率衰减（d = 0.60），左侧中央β波（d = 0.61）和后部α波抑制（d = 0.55）减弱。
items.curatedReasonEn: Athletes with ACL reconstruction (ACLR) show persistent neurocognitive alterations during decision-making under uncertainty, which may increase reinjury risk. When evaluating ACLR athletes for return to sport, consider integrating neurocognitive assessments beyond traditional physical tests.
items.limitation: 这是一项对照实验室研究，环境与真实运动场景存在差异，可能影响结果的生态效度。
items.limitationEn: This is a controlled laboratory study, and the environment differs from real-world sports settings, potentially affecting ecological validity.
items.journal: The American journal of sports medicine

items.title: Feasibility, Safety, and Preliminary Effect Estimates of an Ultrasound-Informed Hybrid Joint-Sparing Rehabilitation Strategy in Patients With Rheumatoid Arthritis: A Prospective Non-Randomized Proof-of-Concept Study.
items.summary: A 12-week ultrasound-informed hybrid rehabilitation protocol in 30 RA patients showed greater pain reduction (ΔVAS: -2.88 ± 0.84 cm vs. -0.60 ± 0.20 cm; p < 0.001; Cohen's d = 3.74) compared to minimal education, with 100% retention and 86% home compliance, but no significant changes in ultrasonographic synovitis.
items.curatedReason: 这项概念验证性研究提示，将超声信息整合到风湿性关节炎（RA）康复计划中是可行的。然而，其非随机设计和过高的效应量估计，限制了你将其应用于临床的依据。
items.titleZh: 超声引导的混合式关节保护康复策略在类风湿关节炎患者中的可行性、安全性及初步疗效评估：一项前瞻性非随机概念验证研究
items.summaryZh: 一项在30例类风湿关节炎（RA）患者中进行的为期12周的超声引导混合康复方案，与最低限度教育相比，疼痛减轻更大（ΔVAS：-2.88 ± 0.84 cm vs. -0.60 ± 0.20 cm; p < 0.001; Cohen's d = 3.74），研究招募率100%，留存率100%，居家依从性86%，但超声滑膜炎无显著变化。
items.curatedReasonEn: This proof-of-concept study suggests that integrating ultrasound information into rheumatoid arthritis (RA) rehabilitation is feasible. However, its non-randomized design and likely overestimated effect sizes limit its clinical applicability.
items.limitation: 这是一项单中心、非随机、小样本的概念验证性研究，对照组干预非常有限，且效应量可能被高估。
items.limitationEn: This is a single-center, non-randomized, small-sample proof-of-concept study with a minimal control intervention and likely overestimated effect sizes.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Walking Capacity and Daily Movement Behaviours After Ischemic Stroke: A Potential Capacity-Performance Gap.
items.summary: In a cross-sectional study of ambulatory ischemic stroke patients, subacute patients had faster gait speed (0.89 vs. 0.71 m/s; p = 0.03) and shorter TUG times (15.9 vs. 19.0 s; p = 0.03) than acute patients, but both groups accumulated high sedentary time (∼12 hours/day). Gait speed was the only walking capacity measure associated with daily movement behaviors.
items.curatedReason: 卒中患者在急性期和亚急性期存在“能力-表现”差距：尽管步行能力有所恢复，但每日久坐时间仍高达约12小时。这提示你在康复中不仅要关注步行能力的提高，更要加入改善日常运动行为的干预。
items.titleZh: 缺血性卒中后的步行能力和日常运动行为：潜在的能力-表现差距
items.summaryZh: 一项对可活动缺血性卒中患者的横断面研究发现，亚急性期患者的步速（0.89 vs. 0.71 m/s; p = 0.03）和计时起立行走（TUG）时间（15.9 vs. 19.0 s; p = 0.03）均优于急性期患者，但两组患者每日久坐时间均较高（约12小时/天）。步速是唯一与日常运动行为相关的步行能力指标。
items.curatedReasonEn: Stroke patients exhibit a "capacity-performance" gap in acute and subacute phases: despite walking capacity recovery, daily sedentary time remains around 12 hours. This suggests that your rehabilitation should not only focus on improving walking capacity but also include interventions to enhance daily movement behaviors.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面研究，无法建立因果关系，且样本量较小。
items.limitationEn: This is a cross-sectional study that cannot establish causality and has a small sample size.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Feasibility and Preliminary Effects of Oropharyngeal Alignment Exercise on Swallowing Function in Neurological Disorders with Restricted Mouth Opening: A Pilot Study.
items.summary: A single-arm pilot study with 9 participants (7 stroke, 1 Parkinson's) found oropharyngeal alignment exercise feasible and well-tolerated, with most showing increased maximal mouth opening (6-13 mm) and statistically significant improvements in MASA, GUSS, and PAS scores, particularly for semisolid boluses.
items.curatedReason: 这项初步研究表明，口咽对齐训练在有吞咽困难和口部张开受限的神经系统疾病患者中是可行且耐受性良好的。如果你的患者也有类似症状，可以留意后续更大规模的对照试验。
items.titleZh: 口咽对齐训练对伴口张受限的神经系统疾病患者吞咽功能的可行性及初步效果：一项预试验
items.summaryZh: 一项对9名参与者（7名卒中，1名帕金森病）进行的单臂预试验发现，口咽对齐训练可行且耐受性良好，大多数参与者最大口张开度增加6-13毫米，MASA、GUSS和PAS评分统计学显著改善，尤其对半固体团块效果明显。
items.curatedReasonEn: This preliminary study indicates that oropharyngeal alignment exercise is feasible and well-tolerated in neurological patients with dysphagia and restricted mouth opening. If your patients present with similar symptoms, keep an eye on future larger-scale controlled trials.
items.limitation: 这是一项单臂先导研究，样本量小，且缺乏对照组，无法推断干预的因果效应。
items.limitationEn: This is a single-arm pilot study with a small sample size and no control group, preventing causal inference of the intervention's effects.

items.title: Neurorehabilitation as an Opportunity for Structured Post-Stroke Lipid Management: A Narrative Review.
items.summary: This narrative review found that intensive LDL-C reduction improves secondary stroke prevention, citing evidence from SPARCL, Treat Stroke to Target, FOURIER, and Ez PAVE. It suggests integrating supervised medication titration, adherence monitoring, and risk stratification into neurorehabilitation could strengthen secondary stroke prevention.
items.curatedReason: 卒中后强化血脂管理对二级预防至关重要。这篇综述提示，神经康复可能是落实血脂管理、监测依从性并降低再发卒中风险的关键环节，值得你在临床路径设计时考虑。
items.titleZh: 神经康复：结构化卒中后血脂管理的机会：一篇叙述性综述
items.summaryZh: 这篇叙述性综述发现，强化降低低密度脂蛋白胆固醇（LDL-C）可改善卒中二级预防，并引用了SPARCL、Treat Stroke to Target、FOURIER和Ez PAVE的研究证据。综述建议，将监督用药滴定、依从性监测和风险分层整合到神经康复中，可能加强卒中二级预防。
items.curatedReasonEn: Intensive lipid management is crucial for secondary prevention after stroke. This review suggests that neurorehabilitation could be a key setting for implementing lipid management, monitoring adherence, and reducing recurrent stroke risk. Consider this when designing your clinical pathways.
items.limitation: 这是一篇叙述性综述，可能存在选择偏倚，且未提供量化证据。
items.limitationEn: This is a narrative review, potentially subject to selection bias and not providing quantitative evidence.

items.title: Beyond Reconstruction: Return to Olympic Medal Performance Following Morphology-Informed and Criterion-Based Nonoperative Management of a Femoral-Sided Sherman Type II ACL Injury - A Case Report.
items.summary: An elite field hockey player with a femoral-sided Sherman type II ACL injury successfully returned to Olympic medal performance (silver medal 200 days post-injury) after morphology-informed nonoperative management and criterion-based rehabilitation. The athlete resumed international competition at 140 days post injury.
items.curatedReason: 这个病例报告展示了在对侧股骨谢尔曼II型ACL损伤精英运动员中，形态学引导下的非手术管理结合基于标准的康复治疗，最终能帮助运动员重返高水平竞技。这提示我们，特定ACL损伤表型下非手术治疗可能是一个可行路径，挑战了传统上对精英运动员的治疗假设。
items.titleZh: 超越重建：股骨侧谢尔曼II型ACL损伤形态学引导和基于标准的非手术管理后重返奥运奖牌水平表现——一个病例报告
items.summaryZh: 一名股骨侧谢尔曼II型ACL损伤的精英曲棍球运动员在形态学引导的非手术管理和基于标准的康复后，成功恢复至奥运奖牌水平（伤后200天获得银牌）。该运动员在伤后140天恢复国际比赛。
items.curatedReasonEn: This case report demonstrates that morphology-informed nonoperative management combined with criterion-based rehabilitation can help elite athletes with femoral-sided Sherman type II ACL injuries return to high-level competition. This suggests a viable nonoperative pathway for specific ACL injury phenotypes, challenging traditional treatment assumptions for elite athletes.
items.limitation: 这是一篇单例报告，证据等级低，结果外推性受限。
items.limitationEn: This is a single case report, providing low-level evidence with limited generalizability.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Diagnosis, Rehabilitation, and Return to Sport after Athletic Hamstring Injury: An ICCUS Society Consensus Statement.
items.summary: An ICCUS Society consensus statement, developed via a modified Delphi process with 17 experts, achieved 89.88% agreement on 54 out of 60 statements regarding athletic hamstring injury management. Key recommendations include standardized terminology, criterion-based rehabilitation, progressive tissue loading, and integrating various factors for return to sport decisions.
items.curatedReason: 这份来自 ICCUS 协会的专家共识声明为腘绳肌腱损伤的诊断、康复和重返运动提供了统一框架。它强调了个性化、基于标准的康复，逐步负荷，并整合损伤分类、功能表现和客观测试，这对你在临床中指导运动员康复和决策重返赛场具有重要指导意义。
items.titleZh: 运动性腘绳肌损伤的诊断、康复和重返运动：ICCUS 协会共识声明
items.summaryZh: 一份通过改良德尔菲法由 17 位专家制定的 ICCUS 协会共识声明，在运动性腘绳肌损伤管理的 60 条陈述中，有 54 条达成 89.88% 的共识。关键建议包括标准化术语、基于标准的康复、渐进式组织负荷，以及整合多种因素来决策重返运动。
items.curatedReasonEn: This expert consensus statement from the ICCUS Society provides a unified framework for diagnosing, rehabilitating, and returning to sport after hamstring injuries. It emphasizes individualized, criterion-based rehabilitation, progressive loading, and integrating injury classification, functional presentation, and objective testing, which is highly relevant for guiding athlete rehabilitation and return-to-play decisions in your clinical practice.
items.limitation: 专家共识可能受到专家自身偏见的影响，且证据等级通常低于高质量的随机对照试验。
items.limitationEn: Expert consensus may be influenced by inherent biases of the experts, and its evidence level is generally lower than high-quality RCTs.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Neurocognitive Factors in ACL Injury: The Missing Piece in Rehabilitation and Prevention? A Scoping Review.
items.summary: A scoping review of 42 studies published between 2006 and 2026 suggests neurocognitive factors, particularly dual-task interference and visual attention, are significant contributors to ACL injury and should be integrated into rehabilitation and return-to-sport testing. Neurocognitive training interventions show potential benefits in improving visuomotor efficiency and movement compliance.
items.curatedReason: 这项范围综述指出，神经认知因素在 ACL 损伤康复和预防中可能是一个被忽视的关键环节，尤其是在双任务干扰和视觉注意力方面。它提示你在康复方案中考虑加入神经认知训练，以更好地识别和管理再次损伤风险。
items.titleZh: ACL 损伤中的神经认知因素：康复和预防中缺失的一环？一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对 2006 年至 2026 年间发表的 42 项研究进行的范围综述表明，神经认知因素，特别是双任务干扰和视觉注意力，是 ACL 损伤的重要诱因，应将其整合到康复和重返运动测试中。神经认知训练干预在改善视动效率和运动依从性方面显示出潜在益处。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review suggests that neurocognitive factors, especially dual-task interference and visual attention, may be a crucial missing piece in ACL injury rehabilitation and prevention. It indicates that you should consider incorporating neurocognitive training into rehabilitation programs to better identify and manage re-injury risk.
items.limitation: 现有证据主要来自实验室和探索性研究，缺乏前瞻性临床转化数据，因此临床实践的直接指导意义有限。
items.limitationEn: Current evidence is predominantly from laboratory-based and exploratory studies, lacking prospective and clinically translational data, thus limiting direct clinical applicability.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Healthcare professionals' perceptions and experiences of promoting physical activity in persons with multiple sclerosis: a systematic review of qualitative evidence.
items.summary: A systematic review of eight studies found that healthcare professionals' perceptions and experiences of promoting physical activity in persons with multiple sclerosis are influenced by professional, organizational, social, and patient-related factors. Improving promotion requires MS-specific education and training, practical resources, and stronger cross-sector coordination.
items.curatedReason: 如果你在帮助多发性硬化症（MS）患者增加体育活动，需认识到这不仅仅是患者的依从性问题。这份系统综述指出，我们自己的专业知识、机构支持、社会环境和患者特异性因素都扮演重要角色，提示我们要从MS专项教育、实用资源和跨部门协作入手改进。
items.titleZh: 医疗专业人员在多发性硬化症患者中促进体育活动的看法和经验：一项定性证据的系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 8 项研究的系统综述发现，医疗专业人员在多发性硬化症患者中促进体育活动的看法和经验受到专业、组织、社会和患者相关因素的影响。改善这一工作需要 MS 专项教育和培训、实用资源以及更强的跨部门协作。
items.curatedReasonEn: If you're promoting physical activity in persons with multiple sclerosis (MS), recognize it's not just about patient adherence. This systematic review indicates that our professional knowledge, organizational support, social environment, and patient-specific factors all play a role, suggesting we need to improve MS-specific education, practical resources, and cross-sector coordination.
items.limitation: 本系统综述仅限于定性证据，可能无法提供定量效果评估或干预措施的强度等级。
items.limitationEn: This systematic review is limited to qualitative evidence, which may not provide quantitative effect assessments or strength of intervention measures.

items.title: Adherence System Usability Patient Experience and Psychosocial Impact in Robot Assisted Gait Neurorehabilitation A Cross Sectional Study.
items.summary: A single-center observational study of 250 adults in robot-assisted gait neurorehabilitation found that greater attendance, usability (SUS score 72.79 ± 12.06), and rehabilitation experience (NREQ score 27.84 ± 4.92) were associated with favorable psychosocial impact (PIADS score 1.67 ± 0.74). Adherence correlated with SUS (r s = 0.41), NREQ (r s = 0.49), and PIADS (r s = 0.53).
items.curatedReason: 这项针对机器人辅助步态神经康复的观察性研究指出，更高的依从性、可用性和康复体验与更好的心理社会影响相关。这提示你，除了技术本身，关注患者的参与度和使用体验也是提升康复效果的关键。
items.titleZh: 机器人辅助步态神经康复中的依从性、系统可用性、患者体验和心理社会影响：一项横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 250 名接受机器人辅助步态神经康复成年人的单中心观察性研究发现，更高的依从性、系统可用性（SUS 评分 72.79 ± 12.06）和康复体验（NREQ 评分 27.84 ± 4.92）与积极的心理社会影响（PIADS 评分 1.67 ± 0.74）相关。依从性与 SUS (r s = 0.41)、NREQ (r s = 0.49) 和 PIADS (r s = 0.53) 均存在关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study on robot-assisted gait neurorehabilitation suggests that greater adherence, usability, and rehabilitation experience correlate with more favorable psychosocial impact. This indicates that focusing on patient engagement and user experience is crucial for enhancing rehabilitation outcomes, beyond just the technology itself.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面观察性研究，无法建立因果关系，且患者诊断异质性高、问卷评估与依从性存在时间错配。
items.limitationEn: This cross-sectional observational study cannot establish causality, and its interpretation is limited by diagnostic heterogeneity and temporal mismatch between questionnaire assessment and attendance.

items.title: Gamified Versus Traditional Balance Training: Effects on Balance and Motivation in Collegiate Student-Athletes.
items.summary: A quasi-experimental controlled trial with 30 collegiate athletes found that both gamified (Wii Fit) and traditional (wobble board) balance training improved mSEBT composite scores by +21.6 cm (d = 1.84) and +18.5 cm (d = 1.54) respectively, compared to control. Gamified training significantly increased intrinsic motivation (IMI interest/enjoyment: 5.0 ± 1.2 vs. 3.2 ± 1.3, p < 0.01).
items.curatedReason: 别再认为游戏化训练只是噱头了。这项针对 30 名大学运动员的研究提示，Wii Fit 平衡训练在改善动态平衡方面，效果不输传统摇摆板，且能显著提升运动员的内在兴趣和享受。在临床实践中，这正是提高患者依从性、让训练更有趣的有效策略。
items.titleZh: 游戏化与传统平衡训练：对大学学生运动员平衡和动机的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 30 名大学运动员的准实验对照试验发现，游戏化（Wii Fit）和传统（摇摆板）平衡训练均能改善 mSEBT 综合评分，分别提高 21.6 厘米（d = 1.84）和 18.5 厘米（d = 1.54），优于对照组。游戏化训练显著提高了内在动机（IMI 兴趣/享受：5.0 ± 1.2 vs. 3.2 ± 1.3，p < 0.01）。
items.curatedReasonEn: Don't dismiss gamified training as a mere gimmick. This study with 30 collegiate athletes suggests that Wii Fit balance training is comparable to traditional wobble board training for improving dynamic balance, while significantly boosting intrinsic interest and enjoyment. In clinical practice, this is a viable strategy to enhance patient adherence and make rehabilitation more engaging.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量相对较小（30 名运动员），且主要为女性（25 名），结果外推性受限。
items.limitationEn: The study involved a relatively small sample size (30 athletes) and was predominantly female (25), limiting generalizability.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Ultrasound-Guided Percutaneous Tendon Dry Needling for Recalcitrant Distal Biceps Tendinopathy: A Case Series.
items.summary: A case series of two recreationally active adults with chronic distal biceps tendinopathy demonstrated reduced pain and disability at 6 months following ultrasound-guided percutaneous tendon dry needling and a graded loading program. Both subjects exceeded the minimal clinically important difference for outcome measures at 5 weeks, persisting at 6 months.
items.curatedReason: 这组病例报告提示，超声引导下肌腱干针结合分级负荷训练，可能有助于远端肱二头肌肌腱病患者的疼痛缓解和功能改善。在你遇到难治性病例时，可以考虑作为辅助手段。
items.titleZh: 超声引导下经皮肌腱干针治疗难治性远端肱二头肌肌腱病：病例系列
items.summaryZh: 一项对两名慢性远端肱二头肌肌腱病成人进行的病例系列研究显示，在超声引导下经皮肌腱干针并结合分级负荷训练后，两名受试者在 6 个月时疼痛和残疾均有减轻。所有结果指标在 5 周时均超过了最小临床重要差异，并持续至 6 个月。
items.curatedReasonEn: This case series suggests that ultrasound-guided percutaneous tendon dry needling combined with a graded loading program may help reduce pain and improve function in patients with recalcitrant distal biceps tendinopathy. Consider it as an adjunct for challenging cases.
items.limitation: 本研究为病例系列，样本量仅为 2 例，且缺乏对照组，外推性非常有限。
items.limitationEn: This case series included only two subjects and lacked a control group, severely limiting generalizability.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Effects of Medium-frequency Electrical Stimulation Combined with Near-Infrared Light on Quadriceps Function and Independent Walking in Patients with Spinal Cord Injury.
items.summary: A two-phase non-randomized study involving 18 SCI individuals suggests combined medium-frequency electrical stimulation and near-infrared therapy may improve muscle activation, femoral artery blood-flow velocity, and walking ability, though findings are preliminary.
items.curatedReason: 这项初步研究提示，中频电刺激结合近红外光可能对脊髓损伤患者的股四头肌功能和步行能力有益，但需要更大规模的随机研究进一步验证。
items.titleZh: 中频电刺激联合近红外光对脊髓损伤患者股四头肌功能及独立步行的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项两阶段非随机研究对 18 名脊髓损伤患者进行评估，结果提示中频电刺激结合近红外光治疗可能改善肌肉激活、股动脉血流速度和步行能力，但这些发现仍是初步的。
items.curatedReasonEn: This preliminary study suggests that medium-frequency electrical stimulation combined with near-infrared light may benefit quadriceps function and walking ability in spinal cord injury patients, but larger randomized studies are needed for confirmation.
items.limitation: 研究设计为非随机对照试验，且样本量小，结果需谨慎解读。
items.limitationEn: The study design is a non-randomized controlled trial with a small sample size, requiring cautious interpretation of the results.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Development of a Single-Camera Markerless Motion Capture System for Assessing Upper Limb Function Post-Stroke (FULMA).
items.summary: A prospective observational study (N=39 stroke, N=19 controls) found that the Functional Upper Limb Movement Assessment (FULMA), a single-camera markerless motion capture system, achieved 83.3% mean accuracy in predicting stroke participants' ordinal task performance scores, showing preliminary agreement with therapist ratings.
items.curatedReason: 这个单摄像头无标记运动捕捉系统（FULMA）在卒中后上肢功能评估上显示出初步的与治疗师评分的一致性，未来有望提高评估的客观性和敏感性。在你考虑引入这类技术时，需关注其外部验证和测量属性。
items.titleZh: 开发用于评估卒中后上肢功能的单摄像头无标记运动捕捉系统（FULMA）
items.summaryZh: 一项前瞻性观察研究（39 名卒中患者，19 名健康对照）发现，单摄像头无标记运动捕捉系统 FULMA 在预测卒中患者上肢任务表现评分方面达到了 83.3% 的平均准确率，显示出与治疗师评分的初步一致性。
items.curatedReasonEn: The single-camera markerless motion capture system (FULMA) shows preliminary agreement with therapist ratings for post-stroke upper limb function, potentially offering more objective and sensitive assessments. When considering such technologies, focus on external validation and measurement properties.
items.limitation: 这是一项初步开发研究，需要在临床环境中进行外部验证和测量属性评估。
items.limitationEn: This is a preliminary development study, requiring external validation and evaluation of measurement properties in clinical settings.

items.title: Conservative and Post-Operative Rehabilitation Protocols for Hip Dysplasia in Adolescents to Adulthood: A Literature Review.
items.summary: A literature review identified 12 sources on rehabilitation for hip dysplasia (DDH) in adolescents and adults, finding that physiotherapy is a central component of conservative and post-operative management, with multimodal, criterion-based approaches incorporating progressive strengthening and neuromuscular retraining most consistently described.
items.curatedReason: 这项文献综述强调了物理治疗在髋关节发育不良（DDH）保守和术后康复中的核心作用。它巩固了以渐进性强化和神经肌肉再训练为基础的多模式、基于标准的康复方法，这为你优化 DDH 患者的功能预后提供了扎实的证据支持。
items.titleZh: 青少年至成人髋关节发育不良的保守及术后康复方案：文献综述
items.summaryZh: 一项文献综述确定了 12 篇关于青少年和成人髋关节发育不良（DDH）康复的文献，发现物理治疗是保守和术后管理的核心组成部分，其中多模式、基于标准的、结合渐进性强化和神经肌肉再训练的方法被最一致地描述。
items.curatedReasonEn: This literature review underscores the central role of physical therapy in both conservative and post-operative rehabilitation for hip dysplasia (DDH). It solidifies multimodal, criterion-based approaches emphasizing progressive strengthening and neuromuscular retraining, providing robust evidence to optimize functional outcomes for DDH patients.
items.limitation: 证据基础受限于方法学异质性、小样本量和对专家共识的依赖，缺乏高质量的比较试验。
items.limitationEn: The evidence base is limited by methodological heterogeneity, small sample sizes, and reliance on expert consensus, with no high-quality comparative trials identified.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Interactive Gardening Intervention for Preschoolers With Developmental Delays: A Family-Centered Feasibility Study.
items.summary: A non-randomized controlled pretest-posttest study (N=60 dyads) found that an interactive, family-centered gardening intervention significantly improved social functioning within the intervention group (mean change, 3.34 ± 9.47; p = .007) among preschoolers with developmental delays, and was feasible and well accepted.
items.curatedReason: 这项初步研究提示，以家庭为中心、互动式的园艺干预对发育迟缓学龄前儿童的社会功能有积极影响，并且具有良好的可行性和接受度。你可以将其视为早期干预中支持社会参与的补充方法。
items.titleZh: 针对发育迟缓学龄前儿童的互动式园艺干预：一项以家庭为中心的可行性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项非随机对照前后测研究（60 对亲子）发现，一项互动式、以家庭为中心的园艺干预显著改善了发育迟缓学龄前儿童干预组的社会功能（平均变化 3.34 ± 9.47；p = .007），且该干预可行并被良好接受。
items.curatedReasonEn: This pilot study suggests that a family-centered, interactive gardening intervention positively impacts social functioning in preschoolers with developmental delays and is feasible and well-accepted. You can consider it a complementary approach to support social participation in early intervention.
items.limitation: 该研究为非随机对照设计，且样本量相对较小，对感官整合和照护者相关结局未显示显著改善。
items.limitationEn: The study uses a non-randomized controlled design with a relatively small sample size, and did not show significant improvements in sensory integration or caregiver-related outcomes.

items.title: Cardiorespiratory training after stroke or transient ischemic attack in the United Kingdom: A national survey.
items.summary: A national online survey of 253 physiotherapists and exercise professionals in the UK found varied provision of cardiorespiratory training after stroke/TIA, with concerns about adverse events, fatigue, and falls, and common barriers including commissioning, resources, skills, knowledge, and lack of guidelines.
items.curatedReason: 这项英国全国调查揭示了卒中和短暂性脑缺血发作（TIA）后心肺训练的现状、障碍和认知，特别是资源、技能和指南缺乏是主要挑战。这提示你在推动心肺康复时，需关注这些系统性障碍，尤其是那些残疾程度较高的患者可能未获得足够训练。
items.titleZh: 英国卒中或短暂性脑缺血发作后的心肺训练：一项全国调查
items.summaryZh: 一项针对英国 253 名物理治疗师和运动专业人士的全国在线调查发现，卒中/短暂性脑缺血发作后的心肺训练提供情况各异，主要担忧包括不良事件、疲劳和跌倒风险，常见障碍包括服务委托、资源、技能、知识和指南缺乏。
items.curatedReasonEn: This UK national survey reveals the current provision, barriers, and perceptions of cardiorespiratory training after stroke and TIA, highlighting resource, skill, and guideline deficits as key challenges. This indicates that when advocating for cardiopulmonary rehabilitation, you should address these systemic barriers, especially for patients with greater disability who may not receive adequate training.
items.limitation: 研究依赖于自我报告的在线调查，可能存在报告偏差，且未能提供心肺训练的实际效果数据。
items.limitationEn: The study relies on self-reported online surveys, which may have reporting bias and do not provide data on the actual effectiveness of cardiorespiratory training.

items.title: Development and psychometric evaluation of the Severity of Myalgic Encephalomyelitis Scale (SoMES) and the Myalgic Encephalomyelitis Occupational Status Scale (MEOSS)
items.summary: This study developed and evaluated the Severity of Myalgic Encephalomyelitis Scale (SoMES) and the Myalgic Encephalomyelitis Occupational Status Scale (MEOSS) among 995 adults with ME/CFS, finding both scales to be valid and reliable for assessing disease severity and occupational status, with moderate (SoMES k=0.53) and excellent (MEOSS k=0.76) test-retest reliability.
items.curatedReason: 新量表虽初步有效，但请记住，它们只是工具。虽然 SoMES 和 MEOSS 显示出评估 ME/CFS 严重程度和职业状况的潜力，特别是 MEOSS 的测试重测信度达到 k=0.76，但在实际应用中仍需结合患者的整体临床表现。别让量表分数取代你的临床判断。
items.titleZh: 肌痛性脑脊髓炎严重程度量表（SoMES）和肌痛性脑脊髓炎职业状态量表（MEOSS）的开发与心理测量学评估
items.summaryZh: 这项研究开发并评估了肌痛性脑脊髓炎严重程度量表（SoMES）和肌痛性脑脊髓炎职业状态量表（MEOSS），对 995 名 ME/CFS 成人患者进行测试，结果显示这两个量表在评估疾病严重程度和职业状态方面均有效且可靠，重测信度分别为中等（SoMES k=0.53）和优秀（MEOSS k=0.76）。
items.curatedReasonEn: New scales, while preliminarily effective, are just tools. While SoMES and MEOSS show potential for assessing ME/CFS severity and occupational status—especially MEOSS with k=0.76 test-retest reliability—they should always be used in conjunction with a patient's overall clinical presentation. Don't let scale scores replace your clinical judgment.
items.limitation: 研究人群为在线调查参与者，可能存在自我选择偏差，且未在不同临床设置中进行验证。
items.limitationEn: The study population consists of online survey participants, which may introduce self-selection bias, and validation in different clinical settings is still needed.

items.title: Neurological and functional recovery despite persistent skull defect after decompressive hemicraniectomy: a case report.
items.summary: A case report describes a 60-year-old man who showed neurological and functional improvements beyond 6 months after stroke, despite a persistent skull defect following decompressive hemicraniectomy due to infection, with no reproducible syndrome of the trephined.
items.curatedReason: 这个病例报告展示了即使在去骨瓣减压术后颅骨缺损持续存在的情况下，患者仍能实现神经功能和运动的长期改善，这提示康复干预的适应性和重要性。
items.titleZh: 去骨瓣减压术后颅骨缺损持续存在下神经功能和运动恢复：一病例报告
items.summaryZh: 一份病例报告描述了一名 60 岁男性在卒中后 6 个月仍持续存在颅骨缺损的情况下，神经功能和运动能力得到改善，且未观察到复发性骨瓣切除术后综合征。
items.curatedReasonEn: This case report illustrates that even with a persistent skull defect after decompressive hemicraniectomy, long-term neurological and functional improvements can occur, highlighting the adaptability and importance of rehabilitation interventions.
items.limitation: 这是一个单病例报告，结论的外推性受限。
items.limitationEn: This is a single case report, limiting the generalizability of its conclusions.

items.title: Can traditional Chinese exercises help people with musculoskeletal disorders? - BJSM blog - social media's leading SEM voice
items.summary: An umbrella review of 92 meta-analyses (1,744 trials) found high-certainty evidence that Traditional Chinese Exercises (TCEs) improved physical function and mental health in knee osteoarthritis, mental health in neck pain, and sleep quality in fibromyalgia. Tai Chi reduced chronic MSD-related pain and stiffness and increased bone mineral density in osteopenia/osteoporosis.
items.curatedReason: 传统中医运动对多种肌肉骨骼疾病（如膝骨关节炎、颈痛、纤维肌痛、骨质疏松和慢性踝关节不稳）具有高确定性或中等确定性证据支持其改善身体功能、心理健康和疼痛。这将支持您在临床实践中，将太极拳、八段锦、气功等传统中医运动作为常规治疗的补充，但需根据患者情况选择合适的运动类型和剂量。
items.titleZh: 传统中医运动能否帮助肌肉骨骼疾病患者？——BJSM 博客
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入 92 项 Meta 分析（涵盖 1,744 项试验）的伞形综述发现，有高确定性证据表明传统中医运动（TCEs）能改善膝骨关节炎患者的身体功能和心理健康，颈痛患者的心理健康，以及纤维肌痛患者的睡眠质量。太极拳还可减轻慢性肌肉骨骼相关疼痛和僵硬，并增加骨质减少/骨质疏松患者的骨密度。
items.curatedReasonEn: Traditional Chinese exercises have high or moderate certainty evidence supporting their efficacy in improving physical function, mental health, and pain for various musculoskeletal disorders (e.g., knee OA, neck pain, fibromyalgia, osteoporosis, chronic ankle instability). This supports integrating Tai Chi, Baduanjin, and Qigong into your clinical practice as a complement to usual care, tailored to patient diagnosis and symptoms.
items.limitation: 本综述发现不同传统中医运动、不同肌肉骨骼疾病和不同健康结局之间的证据强度存在差异，提示临床应用时需注意个体化选择和评估。
items.limitationEn: This review found varying strengths of evidence across different Traditional Chinese Exercises, MSDs, and health outcomes, suggesting the need for individualized selection and assessment in clinical application.

items.title: Effects of Exercise Type and Duration on Pain, Function, and Quality of Life in Patients With Knee Osteoarthritis: A Systematic Review With Bayesian Network Meta-Analysis.
items.summary: A Bayesian network meta-analysis of 35 trials (n = 3808 patients) found that short-term combined aerobic and resistance exercise had the largest effects on pain (SMD = -0.937, low certainty), function (SMD = -0.590, low certainty), and quality of life (SMD = 0.663, low certainty) in patients with knee osteoarthritis.
items.curatedReason: 针对膝骨关节炎，短期内，有氧运动与抗阻运动结合的干预方案在缓解疼痛、改善功能和生活质量方面效果最佳。运动疗法仍然是膝关节 OA 的一线选择，建议将其整合入常规方案。
items.titleZh: 运动类型和持续时间对膝骨关节炎患者疼痛、功能和生活质量的影响：一项贝叶斯网络 Meta 分析系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入 35 项试验（n = 3808 名患者）的贝叶斯网络 Meta 分析发现，在膝骨关节炎患者中，短期内结合有氧和抗阻运动对疼痛（SMD = -0.937）、功能（SMD = -0.590）和生活质量（SMD = 0.663）的改善效果最大，但证据确定性为低。
items.curatedReasonEn: For knee osteoarthritis, combined aerobic and resistance exercise shows the largest short-term effects on pain, function, and quality of life. Exercise therapy remains a first-line option for knee OA; integrate it into your standard protocols.
items.limitation: 本研究关于长期运动干预临床意义的证据有限，且多数短期的效应估计确定性为低或极低，提示长期效果和证据强度仍需更多验证。
items.limitationEn: Evidence regarding the clinical significance of long-term exercise interventions was limited, and most short-term effect estimates had low or very low certainty, indicating a need for further validation of long-term effects and evidence strength.
items.journal: The Journal of orthopaedic and sports physical therapy

items.title: Effects of sleep manipulation on athletic performance, cognitive function, and recovery: a systematic review of experimental studies
items.summary: A systematic review of 15 experimental studies found that sleep extension generally led to enhanced athletic performance (e.g., +9.5 m in shuttle run, -0.7 s in sprint time, ~3% improvement in endurance), cognitive function, and recovery. Sleep restriction had adverse effects, while daytime napping showed mixed, context-dependent results.
items.curatedReason: 睡眠延长普遍与运动员体能、认知功能和恢复的改善相关（如短跑时间缩短 0.7 秒，耐力提高 3%）。相反，睡眠限制则会产生负面影响。这坐实了睡眠干预在运动康复和表现提升中的重要性，您应将睡眠卫生作为运动员整体康复计划的核心组成部分。
items.titleZh: 睡眠干预对运动表现、认知功能和恢复的影响：一项实验研究的系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入 15 项实验研究的系统综述发现，睡眠延长通常能改善运动表现（例如，折返跑距离增加 9.5 米，短跑时间缩短 0.7 秒，耐力提高约 3%）、认知功能和恢复。睡眠限制则有负面影响，而白天小睡的结果则复杂且具有情境依赖性。
items.curatedReasonEn: Sleep extension is generally associated with improved athletic performance, cognitive function, and recovery (e.g., 0.7s reduction in sprint time, 3% increase in endurance), while sleep restriction has adverse effects. This confirms the importance of sleep interventions in sports rehabilitation and performance enhancement; you should integrate sleep hygiene as a core component of athletes' overall rehabilitation plans.
items.limitation: 本系统综述因纳入研究的设计和测量方法存在差异，采取叙述性综合而非 Meta 分析，可能影响效应量精确估计。
items.limitationEn: Due to variability in study designs and measures, this systematic review utilized a structured narrative synthesis rather than a meta-analysis, which may affect the precise estimation of effect sizes.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Everything You Need to Know About the 2027 Final Rule
items.summary: The CMS 2027 Physician Fee Schedule Final Rule confirms a decrease in conversion factors for both qualifying (-1.83%) and non-qualifying (-2.31%) APMs, but an overall 0.7% increase in pay for rehab therapists due to boosts in PE RVUs for common codes. The KX modifier threshold will be $2,540, and the medical review threshold remains $3,000.
items.curatedReason: CMS 2027 年最终规则确认，尽管总体换算因子下调，但康复治疗师常用代码的实践费用相对价值（PE RVU）在未来几年将有所提升，使康复治疗总体支付有小幅增长。这直接影响您明年的报销收入，应密切关注 Medicare 费率变化并相应调整诊所的财务预测。
items.titleZh: WebPT：2027 年最终规则要点解读
items.summaryZh: CMS 2027 年医师收费标准最终规则确认，合格 (-1.83%) 和不合格 (-2.31%) APM 的转换因子均下降，但由于常用代码的实践费用相对价值（PE RVU）上调，康复治疗师的总体支付预计增加 0.7%。KX 修饰符阈值为 2,540 美元，医疗审查阈值仍为 3,000 美元。
items.curatedReasonEn: The CMS 2027 final rule confirms that despite an overall reduction in the conversion factor, practice expense RVUs for common rehabilitation therapy codes will increase over the next few years, leading to a slight overall increase in rehab therapy payments. This directly impacts your reimbursement next year; closely monitor Medicare rate changes and adjust your clinic's financial forecasts accordingly.

items.title: The Role of Artificial Intelligence in Treatment Planning in Physical and Rehabilitation Medicine: A Systematic Review.
items.summary: A systematic review of 9 studies found that large language models (LLMs) showed promising capabilities in supporting rehabilitation treatment planning, with concordance with expert opinion varying but reaching 98.75% after expert review in some cases. However, included studies reported hallucinations, underscoring the necessity of supervision.
items.curatedReason: 生成式 AI（特别是 LLM）在康复治疗计划中的应用前景广阔，但目前证据仍提示存在"幻觉"风险，需人工监督。将 LLM 纳入康复流程前，仍需更多高质量研究验证其真实世界有效性。
items.titleZh: 人工智能在物理治疗与康复医学治疗计划中的作用：一项系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入 9 项研究的系统综述发现，大型语言模型（LLM）在支持康复治疗计划方面展现出良好前景，在经过专家委员会审查后，与专家意见的一致性最高可达 98.75%。然而，研究也报告了“幻觉”现象，强调了人工监督的必要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: Generative AI, especially LLMs, shows promise in rehabilitation treatment planning. However, current evidence still highlights the risk of "hallucinations" and necessitates human supervision. More high-quality studies are needed to validate real-world effectiveness before integrating LLMs into rehabilitation workflows.
items.limitation: 本系统综述仅纳入 9 项研究，且发现 LLM 产出与专家意见的一致性存在差异，提示研究数量和一致性证据不足。
items.limitationEn: This systematic review included only 9 studies, and found varied concordance between LLM output and expert opinion, indicating insufficient study volume and consistency in evidence.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Comparison of the effects of modified razor curl and nordic hamstring exercises on hamstring muscle strength and posterior-chain endurance in male football players
items.summary: A 6-week RCT (n=45 male football players) found that both modified razor curl and Nordic hamstring exercise protocols significantly improved eccentric hamstring strength and trunk-hip extensor endurance (all p < 0.001) compared to a control group, with no significant difference in bilateral strength. MRCE may represent a practical alternative to NHE.
items.curatedReason: 修正剃刀卷（MRCE）与北欧腘绳肌练习（NHE）均能有效提升男足球运动员的腘绳肌离心力量和躯干-髋伸肌耐力。MRCE 可作为 NHE 的实用替代方案，并且可能支持更大的训练量。这为您在足球运动员腘绳肌损伤预防和康复中提供了更多训练选择。
items.titleZh: 修正剃刀卷和北欧腘绳肌练习对男足球运动员腘绳肌力量和后链耐力的影响比较
items.summaryZh: 一项为期 6 周的随机对照试验（n=45 名男足球运动员）发现，与对照组相比，修正剃刀卷和北欧腘绳肌练习方案均显著提升了腘绳肌离心力量和躯干-髋伸肌耐力（所有 p < 0.001），而双侧力量差异无显著变化。修正剃刀卷可能是北欧腘绳肌练习的实用替代方案。
items.curatedReasonEn: Both modified razor curl (MRCE) and Nordic hamstring exercises (NHE) are effective in improving eccentric hamstring strength and trunk-hip extensor endurance in male football players. MRCE can be a practical alternative to NHE and may allow for greater training volume, offering you more training options for hamstring injury prevention and rehabilitation in football players.
items.limitation: 本研究仅针对 18-23 岁的男性足球运动员，结果对外推至其他年龄段或性别的运动员需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: This study focused only on male football players aged 18–23 years, so results should be interpreted cautiously when extrapolating to other age groups or genders.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Learned helplessness is associated with jump-landing biomechanics following anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction.
items.summary: In 33 individuals post-ACLR, greater learned helplessness was moderately associated with greater peak knee abduction in the ACLR limb (r = 0.564, p = 0.001) during jump-landings, accounting for 34.8% of the variance in peak knee abduction.
items.curatedReason: ACL 重建术后患者的习得性无助感与额状面膝关节生物力学改变有关。这提示您在 ACLR 术后康复和重返运动评估中，除了关注体能指标，也应考虑患者的心理和神经行为因素，以减少再损伤风险。
items.titleZh: 习得性无助感与前交叉韧带重建术后跳跃着地生物力学相关
items.summaryZh: 一项对 33 名前交叉韧带重建术后患者的研究发现，习得性无助感与重建侧肢体跳跃着地时的最大膝外展角度呈中度正相关（r = 0.564, p = 0.001），解释了 34.8% 的峰值膝外展角度变异。
items.curatedReasonEn: Learned helplessness in ACLR patients is associated with frontal plane knee biomechanical alterations. This suggests you should consider psychological and neurobehavioral factors, in addition to physical metrics, during ACLR rehabilitation and return-to-sport assessments to mitigate reinjury risk.
items.limitation: 本研究的样本量较小（n=33），且受试者习得性无助感评分较低，可能限制结果的普适性。
items.limitationEn: The study had a small sample size (n=33), and participants demonstrated low helplessness scores, which may limit the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Severe injuries in competitive cycling during an olympic cycle: injury patterns, time loss, and return-to-performance outcomes
items.summary: A retrospective study of 192 cyclists found 37.5% sustained at least one severe injury (≥3 weeks time loss) over five years. Upper (33.8%) and lower (27.8%) extremities were most affected, with hand and clavicle fractures being most common. Full return to pre-injury performance ranged from 85.7% after hand fractures to 28.6% after AC joint separations.
items.curatedReason: 竞技自行车运动中，严重损伤模式因项目和环境而异，手部骨折和锁骨骨折是最常见的。特别提示您，肩锁关节（ACJ）分离后尽管时间损失中等，但重返受伤前表现的比例很低（28.6%）。这强调了在康复中区分“重返运动”和“重返表现”的重要性。
items.titleZh: 一个奥运周期内竞技自行车运动中的严重损伤：损伤模式、时间损失和重返表现结果
items.summaryZh: 一项对 192 名自行车运动员进行的回顾性研究发现，在五年内有 37.5% 的运动员至少经历一次严重损伤（导致≥3周时间损失）。上肢（33.8%）和下肢（27.8%）是最常受累的部位，手部和锁骨骨折最常见。重返受伤前表现的比例从手部骨折后的 85.7% 到肩锁关节分离后的 28.6% 不等。
items.curatedReasonEn: In competitive cycling, severe injury patterns vary by discipline and setting, with hand and clavicle fractures being most common. Notably, after acromioclavicular (ACJ) joint separations, despite moderate time loss, full return to pre-injury performance was very low (28.6%). This underscores the importance of distinguishing "return to sport" from "return to performance" in rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性在线问卷调查，可能存在回忆偏倚和样本选择偏倚，且比较分析被认为是探索性的。
items.limitationEn: This was a retrospective online questionnaire study, which may be subject to recall and selection bias, and comparative analyses were considered exploratory.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Evaluation of markerless hand-tracking accuracy in VR application designed for hand range-of-motion measurement and rehabilitation
items.summary: A technical pilot evaluation comparing markerless hand-tracking accuracy in VR found Meta Quest's native tracking showed lower MAE in 23 of 24 static configurations and higher median tolerance-band coverage than MediaPipe for thumb-finger distance measurement. Meta Quest tracking appears more suitable for distance-based VR hand rehabilitation applications under tested conditions.
items.curatedReason: Meta Quest 原生手部追踪在测量基于距离的 VR 手部康复应用中比 MediaPipe 更准确，且误差更小。这为开发和实施 VR 康复系统提供了技术参考，但结果仅限于技术验证，还需进一步临床验证。
items.titleZh: 用于手部运动范围测量和康复的 VR 应用中无标记手部追踪准确性评估
items.summaryZh: 一项评估 VR 应用中无标记手部追踪准确性的技术试点研究发现，在拇指-手指距离测量方面，Meta Quest 的原生追踪在 24 种静态配置中的 23 种表现出更低的平均绝对误差（MAE）和更高的中位容许带覆盖率，优于 MediaPipe。Meta Quest 追踪在测试条件下似乎更适合基于距离的 VR 手部康复应用。
items.curatedReasonEn: Meta Quest's native hand tracking demonstrated superior accuracy and lower error rates compared to MediaPipe for distance-based VR hand rehabilitation applications. This provides technical guidance for developing and implementing VR rehabilitation systems, though further clinical validation is needed as these findings represent technical validation only.
items.limitation: 本研究为技术性试点评估，核心比较仅涉及一名健康成年男性，且未进行临床验证，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This study was a technical pilot assessment; the core comparison involved only one healthy adult male and lacked clinical validation, limiting generalizability.

items.title: Effectiveness of a Structured Post-Platelet Rich Plasma Rehabilitation Approach on Pain and Function in Subacromial Pain Syndrome: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=54) found that adding a structured post-PRP rehabilitation approach to conventional physiotherapy significantly improved pain (VAS reduced from 9.00 to 2.92 vs 9.11 to 7.96, p < 0.001) and function in subacromial pain syndrome patients over 21 days, compared to conventional physiotherapy alone.
items.curatedReason: 本 RCT 提示，在肩峰下疼痛综合征患者中，PRP 注射后配合结构化康复方案，短期内可带来额外的疼痛缓解、肌力、关节活动度和肩关节功能改善。但请注意，此方案的长期效果尚未明确。
items.titleZh: 结构化 PRP 术后康复方案对肩峰下疼痛综合征疼痛与功能影响的随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=54）发现，在肩峰下疼痛综合征患者中，PRP 注射后配合结构化康复方案比单独常规物理治疗在 21 天内显著改善了疼痛（VAS 从 9.00 降至 2.92 对比 9.11 降至 7.96，p < 0.001）和功能。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT suggests that a structured post-PRP rehabilitation approach, combined with conventional physiotherapy, can provide additional short-term improvements in pain, muscle strength, range of motion, and shoulder function for subacromial pain syndrome patients. However, long-term effects remain unclear.
items.limitation: 本研究随访期短（21天），无法评估结构化康复方案对 PRP 术后患者的长期效果。
items.limitationEn: The study had a short follow-up period (21 days), preventing assessment of long-term effects of the structured rehabilitation approach post-PRP.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: First-Hand Experience and the Value of Telerehabilitation for Chronic Knee Pain: A Discrete Choice Experiment Nested in a Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A discrete choice experiment (n=319) in Australia found that patients with firsthand experience of telerehabilitation for chronic knee pain were willing to pay AU$87.49 more for telerehabilitation consultations than those who experienced in-person care, with 68% of telerehabilitation arm participants preferring it.
items.curatedReason: 曾亲身体验远程康复的膝关节骨关节炎患者，对其远程模式的接受度和支付意愿明显高于仅接受过线下治疗的患者。这提示了通过试点项目让患者体验远程康复，能有效提升其接受度，对于你在澳大利亚市场推广远程康复服务具有参考价值。
items.titleZh: 亲身体验与远程康复治疗慢性膝关节疼痛的价值：一项嵌套在随机对照试验中的离散选择实验
items.summaryZh: 一项在澳大利亚进行的离散选择实验（n=319）发现，曾亲身体验过远程康复治疗慢性膝关节疼痛的患者，比仅接受过线下护理的患者，更愿意为远程康复咨询多支付 87.49 澳元，其中 68% 的远程康复组参与者更偏好该模式。
items.curatedReasonEn: Patients with knee osteoarthritis who have firsthand experience with telerehabilitation show significantly higher acceptance and willingness to pay for it than those who have only experienced in-person care. This suggests that allowing patients to experience telerehabilitation through pilot programs can effectively increase its acceptance, which is valuable for promoting telerehabilitation services in the Australian market.
items.limitation: 本研究为离散选择实验，虽嵌套在 RCT 中，但结论是基于患者意愿而非直接临床疗效，且研究人群仅限澳大利亚慢性膝关节疼痛患者。
items.limitationEn: This discrete choice experiment, nested within an RCT, bases its conclusions on patient preferences rather than direct clinical outcomes, and the study population is limited to Australian adults with chronic knee pain.
items.journal: The Journal of orthopaedic and sports physical therapy

items.title: Comparison of robot-assisted gait training and visual feedback balance training on balance and gait outcomes in patients with stroke: a randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=50) comparing robot-assisted gait training (RoboGait) and visual feedback balance training (ProKin-252) for stroke patients found both improved balance and functional outcomes. ProKin-252 resulted in significantly greater improvements in Berg Balance Scale (1.43 points, 95% CI 0.37-2.49; p=.009) and fear of falling.
items.curatedReason: 在卒中患者的平衡和步态康复中，视觉反馈平衡训练在改善 Berg 平衡量表分数和减少跌倒恐惧方面略优于机器人辅助步态训练。虽然整体功能改善相似，但这个细节提示你可以考虑将视觉反馈训练作为更针对平衡和跌倒恐惧的辅助手段。
items.titleZh: 机器人辅助步态训练与视觉反馈平衡训练对卒中患者平衡和步态结局的比较：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=50）比较了卒中患者的机器人辅助步态训练（RoboGait）与视觉反馈平衡训练（ProKin-252），发现两者均能改善平衡和功能结局。ProKin-252 在 Berg 平衡量表（1.43 分，95% CI 0.37-2.49；p=.009）和跌倒恐惧方面显示出显著更大的改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: For stroke patients' balance and gait rehabilitation, visual feedback balance training shows a slight advantage over robot-assisted gait training in improving Berg Balance Scale scores and reducing fear of falling. While overall functional improvements are similar, this detail suggests you might consider visual feedback training as a supplementary tool more specifically targeting balance and fear of falling.
items.limitation: 本研究虽然显示视觉反馈训练在某些平衡指标上略优，但其在 Berg 平衡量表上的调整后组间差异（1.43 分）可能不具有临床最小重要差异。
items.limitationEn: Although this study showed slight superiority of visual feedback training in some balance measures, the adjusted between-group difference on the Berg Balance Scale (1.43 points) might not meet the minimum clinically important difference.
